english.note: Use this when emphasizing that the speaker personally did not anticipate the outcome.
Use this colloquial framing when the speaker means that the result was not anticipated.

examples.english: I unexpectedly managed to get tickets so quickly.
examples.traditional: 我估唔到咁快就買到飛。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 m4 dou2 gam3 faai3 zau6 maai5 dou2 fei1

examples.english: They won in the end, curiously enough.
